EX-99.1 2 zura-20261027xex991.htm EX-99.1 Document Exhibit 99.1 Zura Bio Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results and Recent Corporate Updates • TibuSHIELD topline data in hidradenitis suppurativa (HS) remains on track for Q4 2026; enrollment completed with 247 participants randomized, exceeding target • TibuSURE topline data in systemic sclerosis (SSc) remains on track for H1 2027; enrollment completed with 91 participants randomized, exceeding target • NEXUS-PMR, a Phase 2 study evaluating tibulizumab in polymyalgia rheumatica (PMR), remains on track to initiate by year-end 2026 • Cash and cash equivalents of $187.7 million as of September 30, 2026, which is expected to fund planned operations through at least the end of 2028 HENDERSON, Nev.--(BUSINESS WIRE)--October 27, 2026-- Zura Bio Limited (Nasdaq: ZURA) (“Zura”), a clinical‑stage biotechnology company developing novel and differentiated medicines to meaningfully improve the lives of patients with serious and debilitating autoimmune and inflammatory diseases, today announced financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026, and provided recent corporate updates.

We are on track to report topline results from our TibuSHIELD study in HS later this quarter, followed by topline results from our TibuSURE study in SSc in the first half of 2027,” said Sandeep Kulkarni, M.D., co-founder and Chief Executive Officer of Zura.

With cash runway sufficient to deliver results from all three studies, Zura is in a great position to deliver on tibulizumab’s unique potential.” PROGRAM UPDATES Tibulizumab (ZB‑106) Both ongoing Phase 2 studies of tibulizumab, a bispecific antibody designed to neutralize interleukin-17 (IL-17) and B-cell activating factor (BAFF), are fully enrolled and progressing toward topline data, and Zura also remains on track to initiate a Phase 2 study in PMR, the third indication for tibulizumab, by year-end 2026.

Topline data remains on track for the fourth quarter of 2026 and will include the primary endpoint, percent change from baseline in total abscess and inflammatory nodule count at Week 16, as well as the proportion of participants achieving HiSCR50 or HiSCR75.

Topline data remains on track for the first half of 2027 and will include the primary endpoint, change from baseline in modified Rodnan Skin Score (mRSS) at Week 24, as well as measures of lung involvement.
